summary: Bourgeois has a 4.9 Google rating from 274 reviews, ten recent results and a WhatsApp number. Broken policy links and uncaptioned results hold back a clinic that already has strong proof.

findings.problem: The Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions links both go to the homepage, and the Google Maps link uses a placeholder looking ID (cid=123456789).
findings.cost: Missing policy pages are a trust and compliance risk, and a wrong map link sends patients to the wrong place.
findings.fix: Real policy pages and a verified map link.

findings.problem: The ten Recent Results images are labelled only Case 1 to Case 10, with no treatment names, timelines or patient context.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients decide on what was done and how long it took. Bare numbered photos do not tell them.
findings.fix: Captioned before and after cases with treatment and timeline, with patient consent.

findings.problem: No booking form appears on the homepage, and the contact overlay shows only a Submit button with no visible fields. Opening hours appear only in the FAQ.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book has to open another page, and a form with no fields loses the enquiry.
findings.fix: A short booking form on the homepage with visible fields, hours nearby and WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The TikTok address reads @bourjeois.clinic, the footer says Bourgeois Clinic while the site says Bourgeois Dental Clinic, and a review spells the doctor Dr Noor while the site says Dr. Nour.
findings.cost: Inconsistent names and a misspelled social handle make a patient unsure they have found the right clinic.
findings.fix: One consistent brand name and correct social links.

redesign: A proof first homepage that puts your 4.9 rating and captioned results beside every booking button.
A booking form with visible fields, WhatsApp and clear hours.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like dental implants Sheikh Zayed Road and porcelain veneers Dubai.
